name: Grid System Operator (GSO)
description: The entity that operates Peninsular Malaysia's electricity grid from Kuala Lumpur: real-time operation and security of the system, operational planning, scheduling and dispatch, monitoring and control, coordination of grid users, and short- and medium-term transmission and generation planning, including the Thailand and Singapore interconnections. It is a ring-fenced entity inside Tenaga Nasional Berhad rather than a separately listed company.
notes: gso.com.my does not resolve; gso.org.my does. It is authorised under section 22A of the Electricity Supply Act 1990. The Energy Commission describes it as a 'ring fenced entity within TNB responsible for operational planning, real-time re-scheduling, dispatch and control of the grid system', and TNB's 2024 annual report repeats the ring-fencing. Its establishment date and legal form were not established from any loadable primary source.
